supporting_features.feature_phrase: tall section offset from the rounded base
supporting_features.evidence: The upright printed portion rises from one side of the lower rounded body rather than aligning with its center.

supporting_features.feature_phrase: vertical discontinuity at a horizontal layer boundary
supporting_features.evidence: The side outline changes position abruptly where the upper section begins.
Parallel layer lines make the sideways discontinuity between adjacent heights easy to locate.
